summary: Phase 1 (Audit 07_Modern_Java) complete. Per-file Combined Lens scoring across all 74 files via 3 parallel subagents (Ch01-Ch20, Ch21-Ch40, Ch41-Ch69). Initial scoring used 0-5 scale (sub-checks met); merge subagent normalized to rubric's 0-3 scale. Master audit doc produced at repo root AND mirrored to ferment docs folder: `07_Modern_Java_AUDIT.md` (43.6K) with 74-row scoring matrix, 24 flagged files, 26 P2-UPGRADE entries (24 file entries + 2 section heading matches). Diagram inventory also produced: `07_Modern_Java_DIAGRAM_INVENTORY.md` (527 lines) covering 72 teaching files with quality assessment (62 CRYSTAL_CLEAR, 6 NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT, 4 NO_DIAGRAM) and 3 promotion candidates for CL templates (Ch55 step-ladder, Ch42 quadrant, Ch67 WITHOUT/WITH). HE is the dominant gap (50+/74 files at HE=0 or HE=1).
